findings.title: Self-responsibility is bounded by lawful conduct
findings.claim: Within the preceding host frame, taking charge of one's own self includes receiving lawful good and refusing self-invented restriction or transgression.
findings.mechanism: The focus own-self carrier meets 5:87-5:88, which prohibit making good things forbidden, prohibit excess, and join lawful wholesome provision to protection. The contact gives self-responsibility a calibrated boundary: it is neither delegated nor self-created austerity.
findings.reader_payoff: The reader sees a practical limit around the command: personal responsibility does not mean manufacturing extra prohibitions, and permission does not mean excess.
findings.containment: The focus's personal liability remains intact. This native context finding does not summarize the dietary rulings or decide every legal boundary; it uses only the supplied lawful, wholesome, and transgression relation.

epistemic.reason: The native context occurrences and connection rows are exact, but no attached support trust label is supplied for this uncandidate activation.
